_about: Level 1 desktop realtime parameters (plan 15). Every key = {value, source, reason}. source 'design' = chosen by reasoning before any measurement (not a measured number); 'calibrated: <json>@<commit>' = computed by scripts/level1_segment_report.py --write-config on TRAIN clips. Read by src/inference/level1_core.load_level1_config (no defaults in code).

motion_window_ms.reason: median over about 5 frames of a 24 fps webcam: removes one-frame landmark jitter spikes while adding little lag to the still/moving decision

still_speed.reason: hand-lengths per second; a held letter only shows tracker jitter (a small fraction of the palm per frame); to be replaced by the train-clip calibration rule of plan 15 section 3.6 (B6b)

move_over_still_ratio.reason: hysteresis between still and moving so jitter around one threshold does not flip the state every frame

hold_ms_design.reason: upper bound of the hold before a letter is emitted: short enough to feel responsive, long enough that a slow transition between two letters is not taken as a hold

hold_ms.reason: = hold_ms_design until the calibration rule min(hold_ms_design, p10 of the longest still run per train clip) is applied (B6b)

tail_still_keep_ms.reason: = hold_ms until the calibration rule min(hold_ms, p50 of trailing_still_ms over moving train clips) is applied (plan 15 section 3.A.3)

rearm_move_ms.reason: minimum duration of continuous evidence before the segmenter re-arms after an emitted letter: clear motion (M_t >= move_speed) or, when pose_change_rules is true, a hand shape at >= rearm_pose_dist from the shape anchored at the emission (plan 15 lần sửa 3 section 3.2); a deliberate bounce or shift of the hand re-arms for a repeated letter, shorter wobbles do not

pose_change_rules.reason: switch of the pose re-arm rules of plan 15 lần sửa 3 section 3.2 (re-arm on a change of hand shape, stable-shape hold); false until the rules pass gates G1-G6 of step R3 on train clips concatenated by scripts/level1_rearm_check.py; false = the segmenter of step A2a exactly

rearm_pose_dist.reason: placeholder, never read while pose_change_rules is false; replaced in step R2 by rule P1 of plan 15 lần sửa 3 section 3.4 (pose_over_jitter_ratio x p95 over letter train clips of the hand-shape jitter in the longest still run); unit: hand lengths (mean point distance of normalised shapes)

pose_over_jitter_ratio.reason: the pose re-arm threshold is this multiple of the hand-shape jitter seen while one letter is held (same idea as move_over_still_ratio); read only by the calibration of rearm_pose_dist (rule P1), not by the segmenter

hand_lost_ms.reason: a few missed detections in a row are tracker dropouts; a longer absence means the hand left the frame

word_gap_ms.reason: lowering the hand for about a second ends a word; must be >= hand_lost_ms

max_segment_ms.reason: a training clip is one whole sign of a few seconds; older frames are dropped from the buffer so a segment never spans much more than one sign

min_sign_frames.reason: a segment needs a few frames with a hand (at least the checkpoint min_detected_frames, the segmenter takes the larger of the two)

accept_confidence.reason: top-1 softmax probability must be a majority to add a token automatically; lower ones are shown greyed and can be accepted with the a key

top_k.reason: same number of candidates as the web /sequence call (scripts/hand_live_check.TOP_K)

camera_width.reason: requested capture width; matches the 640x480 hauuto training clips (manifest.csv); the real size is read from each frame

camera_api.reason: Windows DirectShow backend; 'msmf' or 'any' can be compared (the value read back is written to the JSON)

camera_buffersize.reason: ask the driver to keep as few queued frames as possible so the newest frame is processed (not every backend honours it; read back into the JSON)

hud_font_size.reason: readable Vietnamese text on a 640x480 window

hud_rolling_frames.reason: number of recent frames used for the rolling p50 per stage shown on the HUD (about two seconds of webcam frames)

font_paths.reason: TrueType fonts with Vietnamese glyphs searched in order when --font is not given; none found -> the app stops with a message (no broken text)
